description.value: Red Barn Market is a locally owned Victoria grocery chain with eight locations across Greater Victoria, emphasizing Island-grown produce and Island-made products. The Latoria Walk location in the Western Communities features a full grocery floor alongside a Smokehouse deli, fresh produce section, Sandwich Bar, and Ice Cream Bar. It sits inside the Latoria Walk mall near Colwood and is noted on the website as a handy stop en route to Royal Bay Beach or Matheson Lake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Latoria Walk location page explicitly lists 'Bike Rack', 'Public Washroom', and 'Ice Freezer' in its amenities section, providing direct confirmation for those fields. The page also describes a full grocery selection, fresh produce, Meat and Deli, and a Sandwich Bar, confirming basic groceries and a food counter. OSM phone (+1 250 590-8133) and address (611 Brookside Road) match the website exactly (250-590-8133, 611 Brookside Rd).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating locally owned grocery store with a confirmed web presence, multiple amenities relevant to touring cyclists, and no indicators of closure.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website full address adds postal code V9C 0C3 not present in OSM tags. The 'Sandwich Bar' amenity is listed but whether items are served hot is not explicitly confirmed.
